scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the April 14 LR-14 communications field exercise as a usable supervised practical by securing its required maintenance isolation window.
Emerging Need: The future session is initially tentative and lacks an isolation request; a yard window is temporarily available, but the prerequisite has not been arranged.
Decision Context: Roster and instructor confirmation later make the exercise actionable, while the case rule identifies the request channel, required session details, and reservation deadline.
Consequence: A timely coordination step can preserve the practical segment without directing rail operations; after the held window is released, the scheduled session can no longer receive that prerequisite in time.

parameter.title: LR-14 Communications and Field Exercise
parameter.description: Planned supervised communications practical for the LR-14 cohort.

parameter.subject: LR-14 exercise roster confirmation pending
parameter.body: The April 14 LR-14 practical remains under review. Nia Calder is the designated instructor, and the operating roster will be confirmed after the March 30 safety review. No field exercise is authorized before that review.

parameter.content: North Yard protection planning has a temporary hold for April 14 from 09:00 to 11:00 against session LR14-2026-04-14. No Facilities Protection request is on file. The hold will be released at noon on March 31 if the request is not received.

parameter.title: LR-14 Communications and Field Exercise
parameter.description: Confirmed supervised LR-14 communications practical. Instructor: Nia Calder. Roster confirmed by safety review.

parameter.subject: LR-14 North Yard protection hold released
parameter.body: The temporary North Yard protection hold tied to LR14-2026-04-14 expired at noon on March 31 and was allocated to another work package. Maintenance cannot provide isolation for the April 14 exercise window, and no replacement isolation window is available before the exercise.
